# 1d: Qobuz module

## Read first

- [sources/qobuz.md](../sources/qobuz.md), [architecture.md](../architecture.md) section Source interfaces, [provenance.md](../provenance.md).
- The As built sections of [1b](1b.md) and [1c](1c.md); qobuz-dl-go's `README.md`, `UPSTREAM.md`, `qobuzdltest`, and the sections Public API, Settings and options, Progress and Result, and downloadsdb of its `docs/design.md`.

## Done when

- `internal/modules/qobuz` implements `Source`, `LinkParser`, `Searcher`, `Resolver` and `Downloader` over qobuz-dl-go `v0.1.0` or later.
- The module is enabled in `main` when `SHELF_QOBUZ_TOKEN` is set.
- shelf's `DownloadsDB` adapter over `downloaded_items` is in use.
- `shelf manage import-qobuz-db <path>` works.
- Every checklist line has its test, against `qobuzdltest`.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Startup | `New`, `GetTokens` and `InitializeClient` in the background after start; until then health says "starting". A failure retries every 5 minutes. | shelf starts even when Qobuz is unreachable. |
| HTTP client | One `*http.Client` without `Timeout`, passed as `Options.HTTPClient`, for API calls and transfers alike. qobuz-dl-go's `DefaultOptions` timeouts apply per call. With `SHELF_QOBUZ_USE_PROXY`, the client goes through `SHELF_PROXY_URL`. | A client `Timeout` would cut long transfers; per-module proxy choice. |
| Links | `ParseLink` calls `GetURLInfo` on the whole URL and maps `/interpreter/` to an artist. | sources/qobuz.md. |
| Search | `Search` maps qobuz-dl-go's search results to `source.Item` with the quality badge rules from sources/qobuz.md. Fewer than 3 characters answers an empty page. | qobuz-dl's rule. |
| Resolve | Albums and playlists come with tracks. Artists and labels come with their albums in one section, sorted by release date, newest first. | The UI panels and the expansion step. |
| Download | Album and track call `DownloadFromID`; playlist calls `HandleID` with the kind `playlist`, which writes the m3u8. Options start from `DefaultOptions()` with the settings from sources/qobuz.md. Progress maps onto `Reporter`, and the `*Result` gives the folders, files and delivered formats. `DownloadResult.Tool` is `qobuz-dl-go <version> porting qobuz-dl <version>`. | Parity with the old bot. |
| Provenance fields | Label, release date, UPC, and per track the Qobuz track ID and ISRC. | provenance.md. |
| Import | Paths outside the music root are kept as they are and logged. `kind` other than `album` and `track` is skipped and counted. | Old rows can point anywhere. |

## Files

```
internal/modules/qobuz/qobuz.go, links.go, search.go, resolve.go, download.go, downloadsdb.go, health.go
internal/modules/qobuz/*_test.go
cmd/shelf/main.go                       enable the module
cmd/shelf/manage_import.go              import-qobuz-db
```

## Doc changes

`docs/sources/qobuz.md` where it differs, `docs/status.md`.

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| Every link form from sources/qobuz.md, including `/interpreter/` | `TestParseLinkForms` |
| A link from another site is not claimed | `TestParseLinkOtherSites` |
| Search maps each type and the quality badges | `TestSearchMapsTypes`, `TestQualityBadges` |
| A query under 3 characters gives an empty page | `TestSearchShortQuery` |
| An album resolves with its tracks; an artist and a label with their albums | `TestResolveKinds` |
| An artist or label without albums, `ErrEmptyContent` from qobuz-dl-go, resolves to an empty section | `TestResolveEmptyCollection` |
| `Formats` lists Max, 24/96, CD and MP3 320, Max first | `TestFormats` |
| A download reports planned tracks, progress and files | `TestDownloadReports` |
| A playlist goes through `HandleID` and its folder gets the m3u8 | `TestPlaylistDownloadWritesM3U8` |
| The module's HTTP client has no `Timeout` | `TestHTTPClientHasNoTimeout` |
| `DownloadResult` carries folders, files and the tool line | `TestDownloadResult` |
| A 401 marks the source unhealthy with "token expired" | `TestHealthTokenExpired` |
| The proxy setting routes the module's requests | `TestProxyOptIn` |
| The `DownloadsDB` adapter answers from `downloaded_items` | `TestDownloadsDBAdapter` |
| The import maps rows, makes paths relative, skips other kinds | `TestImportMapsRows` |
| A second import changes nothing | `TestImportIsIdempotent` |
